shell.devBanner: Hosbah is in development — servers and app deploys work, but expect rough edges.

feedback.capturesDropped: The API did not accept the screenshot and logs, so the report was filed without them.

overview.serversHint: Add a server you already have with a one-line install command, or create one on Proxmox.

servers.description: Servers this team manages through the Hosbah agent.
servers.emptyHint: Install the agent on a server you already have, or create one on Proxmox.
servers.name: Name

new.title: Add a server
new.description: Hosbah manages a server through a small agent that connects out to Hosbah — no inbound SSH needed.
new.byoHint: Any Ubuntu 22.04/24.04, Debian 12/13 or CentOS Stream/RHEL/Rocky/Alma 9–10 machine with internet access. You run one command on it.
new.proxmoxHint: A VM cloned from a cloud-init template, or an unprivileged LXC container.
new.notConfiguredTitle: Proxmox is not configured for this team
new.notConfiguredHint: Add a Proxmox credential (API URL, token, node and storage) before Hosbah can create machines.
new.notConfiguredViewer: Ask an owner or admin of this team to add a Proxmox credential.
new.nameHint: Letters, digits, dot, dash and underscore. Unique in this team.

sizes.small: Small — 1 vCPU, 1 GB RAM, 10 GB disk
sizes.medium: Medium — 2 vCPU, 2 GB RAM, 20 GB disk
sizes.large: Large — 4 vCPU, 4 GB RAM, 40 GB disk

new.installHint: As a user with sudo. It downloads the agent, checks its checksum, runs the enrolment checks and starts it.
new.installRoot: Already root (a container or a fresh LXC)?
new.expires: This command works once and expires {when}.
new.waiting: Waiting for the agent to enrol…
new.enrolledHint: {name} is connected. The enrolment checks are below.
new.how1: Hosbah gives you a one-time install command. It works once and expires after 15 minutes.
new.how2: The installer checks the agent download against its SHA-256, runs the enrolment checks and starts the agent under systemd.
new.how3: The agent dials out to Hosbah, proves who it is with its own key, and only runs operations Hosbah has signed.
new.connectHint: Give Hosbah the address and a root (or passwordless-sudo) login. It detects plain Linux, Docker or Proxmox, installs the agent and imports what already runs.
new.userHint: root, or a user with passwordless sudo.
new.privateKeyHint: OpenSSH or PEM, without a passphrase.
new.secretHint: Used once to install Hosbah's own key and the agent, then forgotten. Hosbah never stores it.
new.registerProxmox: If this is a Proxmox VE node, also add it as a Proxmox provider
new.registerProxmoxHint: Hosbah creates an API token for cloudy@pve on the node so it can create VMs and LXCs there.
new.ipconfigHint: For networks without DHCP, e.g. ip=10.10.10.121/24,gw=10.10.10.1. Leave empty to use DHCP.

detail.checksEmpty: The agent reports checks when it enrols.
detail.pendingHint: Run the install command on the server. The page updates by itself when the agent enrols.
detail.pendingExpired: There is no valid install command. Create a new one.
detail.provisioningHint: Hosbah is creating the machine and installing the agent. Follow the log below.
detail.deleteHintByo: Hosbah forgets {name} and its history; the agent on it can no longer connect. Nothing on the server itself is deleted.
detail.deleteHintProxmox: The Proxmox machine behind {name} is destroyed, then Hosbah forgets it.

ops.title: Operations
ops.description: Typed operations only. Each one is signed by Hosbah and checked by the agent before it runs.
ops.empty: No operations yet. Run one above.
ops.offlineHint: The server is offline: operations wait in the queue until its agent reconnects (for up to an hour).
ops.notEnrolled: Operations become available once the agent has enrolled.
ops.readOnly: Your role can view operations but not run them.
ops.logEmpty: Select an operation to see its log.
ops.logWaiting: Waiting for the agent to start…

discovered.title: Found on this server
discovered.hint: Found at enrolment. Expose a container with a published port behind a hostname — Hosbah adds a proxy host for it.

apps.description: Apps this team deploys from a Git repository to its servers.
apps.emptyHint: Point Hosbah at a Git repository and a server; it builds the image there and serves it through Caddy.
apps.name: Name

domains.noAppsDomain: Hosbah has no shared apps domain yet, so an app is reached through its own domains.

tlsHint.auto: a public certificate, issued once the domain is verified.
tlsHint.internal: a certificate from Caddy's local CA (browsers will not trust it).

domains.txtHint: Add this TXT record at your DNS provider, point the hostname at the server, then verify.

apps.viewerHint: Your role can view this app but not deploy or change it.

actions.rollbackHint: {name} switches to release v{version}. Its image is kept on the server, so nothing is rebuilt.
actions.noPrevious: Rollback needs an earlier release on the server; there is none yet.

deploy.empty: No deployments yet. Deploy to start one.
deploy.select: Select a deployment to see its log.
deploy.logWaiting: Waiting for the server to start…
deploy.following: The newest deployment is followed live.

new.title: New app
new.description: Hosbah clones the repository on your server, builds it with its Dockerfile or Railpack, and serves it behind Caddy.
new.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Unique in this team.
new.repoHint: A public https or git URL.
new.noServersHint: Apps run on a server with the Hosbah agent. Add one first.
new.detectHint: Optional: check how the repository would build before creating the app.
new.advancedHint: Leave empty for the defaults (port 8080). A cloudy.toml in the repository overrides these.
new.createdDeploying: The first deploy is queued. Follow it on the app page.
new.createdHint: Deploy it from the app page.
new.how1: The server's agent clones the repository at the branch you choose.
new.how2: It builds an image with the Dockerfile, or with Railpack when there is none.
new.how3: The new release starts next to the old one and must pass its health check.
new.how4: Caddy switches traffic to it; the previous image is kept for a one-click rollback.

hook.title: Deploy hook
hook.hint: A POST to this URL deploys the app's branch — use it from CI.
hook.once: Copy it now. It is shown only once; Hosbah keeps only its hash.
hook.rotateHint: The current URL stops working immediately.

logs.hint: Relays the app's container logs from the server: the last lines, then follows for a while.
logs.notLive: No release is live, so there may be no container to read.
logs.empty: Fetch logs to see them here.
logs.readOnly: Your role cannot read runtime logs.

env.applies: Changes apply on the next deploy or restart.
env.name: Name
env.revealHint: Revealing a value is recorded in the audit log.
env.removeHint: The variable is removed on the next deploy or restart.
env.nameHint: Letters, digits and underscores; not starting with a digit.

releases.hint: Each successful deploy is a release. Standby releases are kept on the server for instant rollback.
releases.rollbackHint: Traffic switches to v{version} after its health check passes.

settings.title: Build and health
settings.pauseHint: Deploy hook and GitHub pushes are ignored while paused; manual deploys still work.
settings.githubMissingHint: Push-to-deploy through GitHub is not available on this Hosbah yet. Use the deploy hook from CI.
settings.deleteHint: Removes its route, containers and images from the server, and its history from Hosbah.

credentials.description: Provider accounts Hosbah uses: Proxmox to create machines, Cloudflare to manage DNS. Secrets are encrypted with the team key and never shown in lists.
credentials.readOnly: Only owners and admins can see and manage provider credentials.
credentials.addHint: Use tokens limited to what Hosbah needs — a Proxmox token scoped to a Hosbah pool (never root@pam), a Cloudflare token with Zone:Read and DNS:Edit.
credentials.emptyHint: Add a Proxmox credential to create servers on Proxmox, or a Cloudflare token so custom domains and proxy hosts get their DNS automatically.
credentials.name: Name
credentials.fingerprintHint: Proxmox uses a self-signed certificate; Hosbah trusts only this one.
credentials.validate: Check it against Proxmox before saving
credentials.validateHint: Hosbah calls the API URL above with this token. Leave off to save without contacting Proxmox.
credentials.revealHint: The reveal is written to the team's audit log with your name.
credentials.deleteHint: Servers created with “{name}” are kept, but Hosbah can no longer manage their machines.
credentials.cloudflareHint: With this token, a domain or proxy host in one of its zones gets its DNS record created and is verified at once.
credentials.validateCloudflare: Check the token with Cloudflare before saving
credentials.frpEdgeHost: Edge host (how NPM reaches the frp ports)
credentials.npmCert: NPM certificate ID for new proxy hosts

hintFor.cloudflare: With this token, a domain or proxy host in one of its zones gets its DNS record created and is verified at once.
hintFor.frp: Servers without a public address expose their Caddy on a port of this frp server; their domains are published at the public IP.
hintFor.npm: Nginx Proxy Manager as the public edge: Hosbah adds a proxy host for every domain on a tunnelled server, and only ever changes its own.
hintFor.tailscale: A reusable auth key: servers you open a Tailscale tunnel for join your tailnet.

members.description: Everyone in this team and what they can do.
members.removeHint: {email} will lose access to this team straight away.

invitations.description: Invite people by email. Each invitation is a one-time link.
invitations.inviteHint: Choose the role they will have when they join.
invitations.createdHint: Copy this link now — it is shown only once.
invitations.noEmailHint: Hosbah does not deliver email in local development. Send this link to the person yourself.
invitations.emptyHint: Invitations you create appear here until they are accepted, revoked or expire.
invitations.revokeHint: The link sent to {email} will stop working.

tokens.description: Tokens let AI agents and MCP clients act on this team.
tokens.endpointHint: Point your MCP client at this URL with a token as the bearer.
tokens.createHint: Grant only the scopes the client needs.
tokens.createdOnce: Copy it now — it is shown only once and cannot be recovered.
tokens.emptyHint: Create a token to connect an MCP client.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.revokeHint: Clients using “{name}” will be refused from now on.
tokens.expiryHint: The token stops working after this.

scopeHelp.read: See the team and its resources

audit.description: Every change made in this team, newest first.
audit.emptyHint: Changes to the team, members, invitations and tokens are recorded here.
audit.subject: Subject

settings.renameHint: The name everyone in the team sees.
settings.viewerNote: Only owners and admins can rename the team.

account.title: Account

twofa.title: Two-factor authentication
twofa.description: Ask for a code from an authenticator app every time you sign in.
twofa.secretHint: Add it to your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy…).
twofa.otpauthHint: Or open this link on the device with your authenticator app.
twofa.disableHint: Enter a current code to turn two-factor off.

reports.title: My reports
reports.emptyHint: Problems you report with “Report a problem” appear here with their status.
reports.mahaamTitle: Reports go to the Hosbah team’s tracker
reports.mahaamHint: “Report a problem” files your report straight into the Hosbah team’s issue tracker. After you send it, the confirmation shows its issue key (MH-…) — keep it if you want to follow up.

account.challengeExpired: That took too long. Sign in again.
account.codeInvalid: That code is wrong or has expired.
account.codeLoginIntro: We email you a 6-digit code instead of using your password.
account.codeResent: A new code is on its way.
account.codeSentTo: We sent a code to {email}. It expires in 15 minutes.
account.codeWrong: That code is not right. Try the latest one from your app.
account.confirmHint: Enter the 6-digit code your app shows now, to confirm it is set up.
account.currentWrong: The current password is not right.
account.disabled: This account is disabled. Contact the platform's support.
account.forgotIntro: Enter your email and we will send you a code to set a new password.
account.forgotSent: If {email} has an account, a code is on its way. Enter it with your new password.
account.passwordHint: Use your current password to set a new one.
account.qrAlt: QR code to add Hosbah to your authenticator app
account.recoveryHint: Each code works once, if you lose your authenticator. Store them somewhere safe — they will not be shown again.
account.recoveryIntro: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you turned two-factor on.
account.recoveryLeftHint: Unused recovery codes. Make new ones if you are running low.
account.regenerateHint: Enter a current code from your app. Your old recovery codes stop working.
account.resetDone: Your password is set. Every other session was signed out. Sign in with your new password.
account.tooMany: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
account.twoFactorIntro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
account.twofaUnavailable: Two-factor authentication is not available on this server yet.
account.verifyIntro: We emailed you a 6-digit code. Enter it to confirm the address and sign in.

admin.title: Platform admin
admin.description: Platform-wide MCP tokens. They act across every team — keep them few and short-lived.
admin.overviewHint: Everything on this Hosbah install: people, teams, servers and what ran in the last day.

list.unavailable: The API is unavailable. Try again in a moment.
list.network: Could not reach the API. Check your connection.

users.hint: Everyone with a Hosbah account. Promote admins, disable accounts, or remove them.
users.notSelf: You cannot change your own account here.
users.promoted: They are now a platform admin.
users.demoted: They are no longer a platform admin.
users.disabledDone: Account disabled. Their sessions and tokens stopped working.
users.enabled: Account enabled. They must sign in again.
users.disabledNote: Disabled: signing in is refused, every session and MCP token they had is revoked for good, and re-enabling does not bring the tokens back.
users.deleteBody: {email} loses access and leaves every team. This cannot be undone.

teams.hint: Every team on the platform, with what it runs. Suspend a team to freeze it.
teams.name: Name
teams.suspendBody: Everyone in {name} is locked out of the dashboard, API and MCP until it is reinstated. Its servers and running apps keep working.

servers.hint: Every server across every team, with its agent and when it last checked in.
servers.search: Search by name, address or team
servers.name: Name

operations.hint: What the control plane asked servers to do, newest first. Parameters and output are never shown here.

audit.hint: Every platform-admin action: account changes, suspensions and settings.

settings.hint: Who can join, what every user is told, and how much a team may use.
settings.accessHint: How new people get an account.

signup.invite_onlyHint: Only people with a pending team invitation for their email can sign up.
signup.closedHint: Nobody can sign up. Existing accounts keep working.

settings.announcementHint: A banner at the top of every signed-in page. Leave it empty to hide it.

settings.supportHint: Shown to users when something needs a person.

admin.forbidden: This area is for Hosbah platform administrators.

databases.description: Managed Postgres, MySQL and Redis this team's apps connect to.
databases.emptyHint: Provision a Postgres, MySQL or Redis service on one of your servers.
databases.name: Name
databases.versionHint: Leave blank for a current version.
databases.createHint: It runs as a container on the server's private network.
databases.addDatabaseHint: Creates a database and a user with the chosen grants.
databases.createDbFirst: Create a database and user first.
databases.revealHint: The connection string is shown once and the reveal is audited.
databases.attachHint: Injects a sealed DATABASE_URL / REDIS_URL that applies on the app's next deploy or restart.
databases.attachedDone: Injected {variable}. It applies on the app's next deploy or restart.
databases.deleteHint: Its container and volume are removed from the server. This cannot be undone.

approvals.title: Approvals
approvals.description: Destructive calls from MCP tokens that are waiting for a person.
approvals.requireHint: When this is on, an MCP token with the destructive scope cannot delete anything on its own. The call is refused and filed here, and it only goes through after an owner or admin approves it and the caller tries again.
approvals.requireOn: On — destructive MCP calls wait for a person
approvals.requireOff: Off — a token with the destructive scope acts immediately
approvals.disabledNote: Approvals are off for this team, so nothing is being held.
approvals.emptyDisabled: Nothing has been held. Turn the setting above on to start requiring approval.
approvals.approved: Approved. The caller has to run the same call again for it to take effect.
approvals.rejected: Rejected. The call will keep being refused.
approvals.viewerNote: Only owners and admins can approve or reject.

proxy.title: Proxy hosts
proxy.description: Put anything a server can reach behind a hostname with TLS — another container, a NAS, a VM — through that server's Caddy.
proxy.addHint: The server's Caddy terminates TLS and proxies to the upstream, websockets included.
proxy.emptyHint: Add one to route a hostname to any upstream a server can reach.
proxy.upstreamHint: host:port, http://host:port or https://host:port — for example 10.0.0.5:5000.
proxy.skipVerify: The upstream uses a self-signed certificate
proxy.verifyHint: Add a TXT record {name} with the value {value}, then verify.
proxy.removeConfirm: Remove {host}? Caddy stops serving it at once.
proxy.noServers: Enrol a server first — proxy hosts run on a server's Caddy.

sites.title: Sites
sites.hint: Apps running on this server, and its proxy hosts. Open a site to see its canvas.
sites.empty: No sites on this server yet.
sites.workersHint: Workers come from [processes] in cloudy.toml and deploy with the app.
sites.addDatabaseHint: PostgreSQL or MySQL on this server
sites.addBucketHint: S3-compatible object storage (MinIO) on this server
sites.addServiceHint: Provisioned on {server}. Attach it to the app from its page once it is running.

tunnels.title: Tunnels
tunnels.hint: How this server is reached when it has no public address.

imported.noticeApp: Hosbah found this site already running and keeps it in sync with the server. It shows it here but never deploys, restarts, reconfigures or removes it.
imported.noticeDatabase: Hosbah found this database already running on the server. It lists it here but has no credentials for it, so it does not back it up, add users or change it.
imported.removeHint: Hosbah stops showing it. The workload keeps running on the server, untouched.
imported.removeConfirmBody: Only the record is removed; {name} keeps running on the server. Hosbah will not import it again.
